learning: Oscillation did not track kp/track gain cleanly across iterations 7 to 10. Its response to narrowing the track is larger than the gain change alone predicts, so future work should separate the two and consider kd as a damping lever. This final race will show whether a 7 percent gain cut holds s-bend oscillation under 0.16 without losing much progress.
notes: Final package: iteration 10 geometry frozen, kp reduced from 4.2 to 3.9 to hold s-bend steering_oscillation under 0.16. Controller otherwise identical to iteration 10.
rationale: Evidence: iteration 10 (wheel_track 0.085 m, kp 4.2) scored 63.41. Its s-bend steering_oscillation was 0.1617, just over the 0.16 trigger, with line loss at one event per run and no new loss. Oval (0.180 progress) and slalom (oscillation 0.1569) were within limits. The Builder asked for the iteration 10 geometry to be frozen, and the Integrator's pre-agreed rule for a small oscillation breach is a kp reduction, not a geometry change. I therefore keep the geometry exactly at the measured iteration 10 values. Across iterations 7 to 10, oscillation tracked effective turn gain (kp divided by wheel_track) only roughly. Gain 41.7 gave s-bend oscillation 0.138, gain 50 gave 0.145, gain 51 gave 0.159, and gain 49.4 gave 0.162. The measured s-bend oscillation therefore also moved with track width and not just gain. Lowering kp from 4.2 to 3.9 cuts effective gain from about 49.4 to about 45.9 (roughly 7 percent). Iteration 7 suggests this should bring s-bend oscillation to about 0.15 to 0.155. The cost is a likely small loss of s-bend progress, since iteration 7 at gain 41.7 gave 0.1496 against 0.1675 at gain 51. I accept that trade because the oscillation breach is the only measured constraint currently failing. kd is held at 0.3 rather than raised, because raising it is untested and could alter the line-loss recovery. ki 0.05, base_speed 1.5 and last_direction line loss are unchanged. Sensor weights stay proportional to x (-1.0 to +1.0), so a positive signal steers left as the contract requires. I expect s-bend oscillation below 0.16 and slalom oscillation near 0.157, with progress near iteration 10 on the oval. These are predictions, not measurements.
